text: dsh-airdrop 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的文件附件插件，在聊天输入区加入附件入口，并支持把文件或文件夹拖到窗口、粘贴文件后上传到当前会话的工作区。上传内容以附件卡片随消息发送，用户可在发送前查看待发送项目，也能在聊天记录中查看已保存附件并打开可用预览。插件通过分块传输处理文件，并支持失败后的续传；图片、视频和音频等内容可在浏览器中预览。适合需要把本地文件交给 DSH 会话使用，或通过浏览器向远程部署的 DSH 上传资料的用户。安装时使用 web profile，且会话需有工作区目录；不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-airdrop adds file attachments to the DSH web client. Drop files or folders anywhere in the window, paste files into the composer, or use the attachment control to upload them to a session workspace. Attachments travel with chat messages, with browser previews for supported media. Chunked up

dsh-airdrop 的功能「拖放文件和文件夹」：把文件或目录拖到 DSH 窗口任意位置即可开始收集并上传，目标是当前会话。
dsh-airdrop 的功能「分块附件上传」：选定或粘贴文件后，插件创建上传草稿并逐块传送文件字节，支持查询已传偏移以续传。
dsh-airdrop 的功能「聊天附件预览」：已保存附件在聊天记录中以附件节点显示，客户端为可预览媒体请求临时预览地址。
dsh-airdrop 使用前须知：会话必须提供工作区目录，附件内容和元数据保存在该会话的本地工作区中。
能不能把剪贴板里的文件贴到聊天输入框？
I want to preview an attachment in the chat before opening or downloading it.

dsh-airdrop README · ❓ 可能会问：**大文件能传吗?**
能。文件分块上传,网络断了自动续传;网关嫌块太大(返回 413)时会自动调小重试。单文件上限 20 GiB。

**支持哪些格式?**
全部。不按格式拒绝任何文件。"任意格式"指不拦截字节内容,不代表 AI 一定能读懂每种格式;插件也不会自己去执行或解压你的文件。

**空文件夹会一起传吗?**
浏览器一般不报告空目录,所以完全空的文件夹可能不会被保留。

**开多个标签页会怎样?**
同一会话的多个标签页共享一份待发送附件,谁先点发送,谁就带走当时已传完的文件。

**想清理空间怎么办?**
先停掉 DSH,然后只删除该插件对应的会话目录和它的元数据文件(`.dsh/uploads/.universal-attachments/<会话标识>.json`)。不要整个删掉 `.dsh/uploads/`,历史附件链接会失效。

dsh-airdrop README · 🛡️ 要放到服务器上?：DSH 没有内建的多用户认证,别直接暴露到公网。让它只监听服务器本机,用 SSH 隧道访问:

```sh
dsh-airdrop README · 服务器上：dsh web --port 3080

dsh-airdrop README · 你的电脑上：ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080 user@你的服务器
```

然后在本机浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 即可。

text:
dsh-airdrop README · ❓ You might ask：**Can it handle big files?**
Yes. Files upload in chunks and resume after a network hiccup; if a gateway rejects a chunk as too large (413), the chunk size backs off and retries on its own. Up to 20 GiB per file.

**Which formats are supported?**
All of them — nothing is rejected by file type. "Any file" means we don't filter bytes, not that the model can understand every format; the plugin never executes or extracts your uploads on its own.

dsh-airdrop README · ❓ You might ask：**Do empty folders come along?**
Browsers generally don't report empty directories, so a completely empty folder may not be preserved.

**What about multiple tabs?**
Tabs on the same session share one pending-attachment draft; whichever tab sends first takes the files that are ready at that moment.

dsh-airdrop README · ❓ You might ask：**How do I reclaim disk space?**
Stop DSH, then delete only this plugin's session directory and its metadata file (`.dsh/uploads/.universal-attachments/<session-id>.json`). Don't wipe the whole `.dsh/uploads/` tree — history links would stop working.

dsh-airdrop README · 🛡️ Running it on a server?：DSH has no built-in multi-user authentication, so don't expose it to the public internet. Bind it to loopback and reach it through an SSH tunnel:

```sh
dsh-airdrop README · on the server：dsh web --port 3080

dsh-airdrop README · on your machine：ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080 user@your-server
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3080` in your local browser.
